pois.label: AI 大屏 · MB-1 位级同源 bigram
pois.label_en: AI wall display - the MB-1 bigram, bit-exact
pois.detail: 屏上 live 跑的不再是一个「同类模型」,而是 MB-1 芯片的算法本身:同一个 32 位 Fibonacci LFSR、同一个钳位逆 CDF 逐项比较、同一张 4096×16 位转移表(mb1-cdf-data.js,由设计册的 build/mb1_cdf.mem 生成,表的 sha256 前 16 位 660ebf90b488bbbe)。开机先对拍:seed 0x12345678 生成 220 字符与 Python 金标准逐字比,PASS/FAIL 直接打在屏上,红字就是闸变红。表用城市自己的七句火星文训练——屏上打出的每个字,硅片在同一 seed 下会打出同一个。
pois.detail_en: What runs on the screen is no longer a model of the same class but the MB-1 chip's algorithm itself: the same 32-bit Fibonacci LFSR, the same clamped inverse-CDF walk, the same 4096 x 16-bit transition table (mb1-cdf-data.js, generated from the dossier's build/mb1_cdf.mem, table sha256 prefix 660ebf90b488bbbe). On boot it self-tests: 220 characters at seed 0x12345678 are compared character by character with the Python golden and PASS/FAIL is printed on the screen - red text is the gate going red. The table is trained on the city's own seven Mars sentences: every character the screen prints, the silicon would print at the same seed.

pois.physics: 同一张表 + 同一个 seed 决定同一串字符,这是 MB-1 的设计前提:片上没有浮点、乘法、除法,只有 16 位随机数与一串比较,所以软件复刻可以做到逐比特而不是「统计上相似」。屏上的自检就是把这个前提当闸门用。
pois.physics_en: One table plus one seed determines one character stream - that is MB-1's design premise: no float, no multiply, no divide on chip, only a 16-bit random number and a run of compares, so a software replica can be bit-exact rather than 'statistically similar'. The on-screen self-test uses that premise as a gate.

Its MB-1 is the hardware implementation of the wall display's bigram: training stays off-chip, the transition distribution is counted offline into a CDF table written over SPI into on-chip SRAM, and inference collapses to one 16-bit random number and a run of compares. After this round's truth audit (23 claims, each checked against a product in the dossier) the honest state is: RTL, two simulators, Vivado synthesis, Arty bitstream, Yosys sky130 netlist and OpenROAD place-and-route to GDS all have products; the PCB has design files and Gerber but was never ordered; there was no tapeout and no sample exists. 'A gold-lidded ceramic engineering sample sits in the DIP-24 socket' is WITHDRAWN (2026-09-06): design exists, no hardware; basis: no tapeout product anywhere in mars-bigram. The package in the socket of the 3D model is a prop.

pois.detail: 两排 8 台 42U 级机架(0.8 × 1.2 × 2.2 m),后门液冷。电网册(mars-grid@8f74f29)把本站记为 mean 40 / peak 55 kW,来源 derived:「8 机架 × ~5 kW」——那是从 v0 画的 8 个盒子读出来的容量。本轮账 1 把全城已入城单位的知识卡逐张盘点:没有任何一张卡把算力负荷落在本站。城里最大的算力项在射电阵站内(605 GFLOP/s 相关器,60 W),四足犬的导航栈在犬身上(358 MOPS,SoC 3.2 W),宇宙线站 90 W 在站内。到本站来的是数据:每 sol 15.4 GB。所以这 8 台机架是「装机容量,负荷未定价」,卡上如实这么写。
pois.detail_en: Two rows of eight 42U-class racks (0.8 x 1.2 x 2.2 m) with rear-door liquid cooling. The grid dossier (mars-grid@8f74f29) books this site at 40 kW mean / 55 kW peak, source 'derived: 8 racks x ~5 kW' - a capacity read off the eight boxes drawn in v0. This round's account 1 went through every registered unit's card: none of them places a compute load here. The city's largest compute item sits inside the radio array's shelter (605 GFLOP/s correlator, 60 W), the quadruped's navigation stack rides on the dog (358 MOPS, 3.2 W SoC), the cosmic-ray station's 90 W stays on site. What reaches this site is data: 15.4 GB per sol. So the eight racks are 'installed capacity, demand unpriced', and the card says so.

pois.label: 液冷分配单元 CDU · 无冷水机的机房
pois.label_en: Coolant distribution unit - a machine room with no chiller
pois.detail: 火星 0.6 kPa CO₂ 里没有可用的空气冷却(对流系数只有地球的 5%,ops-dog-01 热账),所以机房里没有一台 CRAC:机架后门换热器把热交给二次回路,CDU(西墙内,两台泵 90 rpm)把它换到穿墙的一次回路,再送到户外辐射场。一次回路 330 K 供 / 310 K 回,板面均温 320 K——电子学接受 45–55 ℃ 的温水冷却,而 T⁴ 让 320 K 的板比 300 K 少用 30% 面积。整个链路里只有泵在耗电:PUE 1.08。
pois.detail_en: There is no usable air cooling in 0.6 kPa of CO2 (convection at 5% of Earth's, ops-dog-01 thermal ledger), so the room has no CRAC unit: rear-door heat exchangers hand the heat to a secondary loop, the CDU (inside the west wall, two pumps at 90 rpm) moves it into the primary loop through the wall and out to the radiator field. Primary loop 330 K supply / 310 K return, panel mean 320 K - electronics accept 45-55 C warm-water cooling, and T^4 lets a 320 K panel use 30% less area than a 300 K one. The only power spent in the whole chain is pumping: PUE 1.08.

pois.physics: PUE = (IT + 泵 + 变流损耗 + 控制) / IT。地球机房的 PUE 大头是冷水机与风机;这里没有空气可吹、也不需要制冷,剩下的是把 2 kg/s 工质推过 250 kPa 的功。散热面积是火星上的电表(电网册的话),而这台 CDU 是电表和天空之间的那根线。
pois.physics_en: PUE = (IT + pumps + conversion loss + controls) / IT. On Earth the PUE is dominated by chillers and fans; here there is no air to blow and no refrigeration needed, what remains is the work of pushing 2 kg/s of fluid through 250 kPa. Radiator area is the power meter on Mars (the grid dossier's phrase); this CDU is the wire between the meter and the sky.

pois.label_en: Radiator field - sized by the account
pois.detail: 三排 12 m × 4.5 m 双面黑板,倾 70°(离地面)、上面朝北,排距 6.5 m,合计 162 m² 板面。v0 那面 0.9 m 间距的东西向竖鳍墙是画的;本轮账 3 用两种视因子算法(平行板解析 + 蒙特卡洛射线,含 ε 0.9 的漫反射)重算:鳍间 60% 互视,但它在 320 K 仍能排 69 kW(夜)/ 57 kW(昼)/ 49 kW(昼含东西面上的太阳)——比预注册的 20–45 kW 高,预期打错方向,如实记。推翻它的不是排热量,是白天:积尘 α 0.68 让任何朝天的面在正午被太阳吃掉一半以上,而近竖直、南北朝向的板受太阳最少。最坏晴天正午(夏至 83° 高度角)每 m² 板面净排 570 W,夜里 889 W;55 kW 峰值 × PUE 1.08 = 59.4 kW 要 104 m²,建 162 m²:夜 144 kW、最坏昼 92 kW、地面 280 K 时 79 kW。
pois.detail_en: Three rows of 12 x 4.5 m two-sided black panels, tilted 70 degrees from horizontal with the top face north, rows 6.5 m apart, 162 m2 of panel in all. The v0 wall of east/west fins at 0.9 m pitch was a drawing; this round's account 3 recomputed it two ways (parallel-plate analytic + Monte-Carlo rays with eps 0.9 diffuse reflection): 60% of the inter-fin radiation is mutual, yet at 320 K it still rejects 69 kW (night) / 57 kW (day) / 49 kW (day with sun on the E/W faces) - more than the pre-registered 20-45 kW, a miss in direction, recorded as such. What overturns it is not the number but the daytime: with dust at alpha 0.68 any sky-facing surface loses more than half its rejection to the noon sun, while a near-vertical panel facing north/south takes the least sun. At the worst clear noon of the year (solstice, 83 degrees elevation) each m2 of panel rejects 570 W net, 889 W at night; 55 kW peak x PUE 1.08 = 59.4 kW needs 104 m2; 162 m2 built: 144 kW at night, 92 kW worst day, 79 kW with the ground at 280 K.

pois.physics: 斯特藩–玻尔兹曼:q = εσ(T⁴ − F_sky·T_sky⁴ − F_gnd·T_gnd⁴) − α·G。火星没有对流,面元只和它看得见的东西换热:天空(210 K,冷汇)、地面(白天 260 K,几乎不冷)、和太阳(积尘后 α 0.68,正午 400 W/m² 的吸收与 320 K 板的 600 W/m² 发射同量级)。所以在积尘的火星上,「朝天」不是好方向,「少见太阳」才是;而 pwr-radiator-01 敢用朝天板,是因为 600 K 的 T⁴ 把太阳项压成了零头。
pois.physics_en: Stefan-Boltzmann: q = eps sigma (T^4 - F_sky T_sky^4 - F_gnd T_gnd^4) - alpha G. With no convection a surface element exchanges only with what it sees: the sky (210 K, the cold sink), the ground (260 K by day, barely cold) and the sun (dusted alpha 0.68: 400 W/m2 absorbed at noon is the same order as a 320 K panel's 600 W/m2 emission). On dusty Mars 'facing the sky' is therefore not the good direction, 'seeing little sun' is - and pwr-radiator-01 can afford sky-facing panels because at 600 K the T^4 term makes the solar term a rounding error.

pois.label_en: Switchboard and UPS - feeder check and island share
pois.detail: 东墙两台柜:±10 kV DC 进线变流柜与 UPS。本站挂在电网册的 G-C 北干线(±10 kV DC,设计 1200 kW,95 mm² Al),同线服务 res-rodwell-01、res-tank-02、sci-rad-02。上周村支线出过「按 90 kW 定、峰值早记了 158 kW」的缺陷,本轮按同样的法子核:四单位峰值之和 70 kW = 干线的 5.8%,没有那类缺陷(两单位不在电网负荷表里,列出不定价)。孤岛:电网册给本站 T3、4.8 kW,理由「SCADA 靠站内一台小 UPS」——本站没有 SCADA(电网册自己的 scada 卡把它放在控制间),这 4.8 kW 不由本站背书,本册登记 0 kW 强制份额。
pois.detail_en: Two cabinets on the east wall: the +/-10 kV DC incoming converter and the UPS. The site hangs on the grid dossier's G-C north trunk (+/-10 kV DC, designed for 1200 kW, 95 mm2 Al), shared with res-rodwell-01, res-tank-02 and sci-rad-02. Last week the village spur turned out to be rated at 90 kW against a 158 kW peak already booked; this feeder is checked the same way: the four served peaks sum to 70 kW = 5.8% of the trunk, no such defect (two of the units have no row in the grid's load table and are listed, not priced). Islanding: the grid dossier books this site as tier 3 at 4.8 kW because 'the SCADA function rides on a small UPS inside it' - there is no SCADA here (the grid's own scada card puts it in the control room), so the 4.8 kW is not endorsed and this ledger books a mandatory island share of 0 kW.

pois.physics: 孤岛份额不是「重不重要」,是「断一次付什么代价」(电网册的分级判据)。计算中心断电丢的是渲染和归档的实时性,数据本身在盘上;而生存层每一瓦都在维持人活着。所以份额是 0——除非总控点名一项非它不可的功能并给它定价。
pois.physics_en: An island share is not about importance but about what a loss costs (the grid dossier's tier criterion). Cutting the compute centre loses the real-time part of rendering and archiving; the data stays on disk. Every watt of the survival tier keeps people alive. So the share is 0 - unless the integrator names a function only this site can carry and prices it.

pois.label_en: Fibre entry - 15 GB/sol in, Earth takes 11
pois.detail: 东墙南端的橙色柜是地面站光纤进本站的落点(com-station-01:中继→站下行 600 Mbps,站→中继上行 100 Mbps,埋沟光纤 + 电备份出站)。本站每 sol 收 15.4 GB 科学数据(轨道器 11.7、射电动态谱 3.6、火震 0.08、宇宙线 0.02、犬 ~0.02);而整个行星对地球的干线均值只有 0.965 Mbps = 10.7 GB/sol(中继卡:65 Tb/会合周期)。收比发多 1.44 倍——本站不是转发站,是科学数据落地、压缩、留存的地方,地球拿到的是一份选集。中继卡从它那边说的是同一句话:「科学产出的硬顶是对地干线」。
pois.detail_en: The orange cabinet at the south end of the east wall is where the ground station's fibre lands (com-station-01: relay-to-station downlink 600 Mbps, station-to-relay uplink 100 Mbps, buried fibre plus electrical backup out). The site takes in 15.4 GB of science data per sol (orbiter 11.7, radio dynamic spectrum 3.6, seismic 0.08, cosmic-ray 0.02, dog ~0.02); the whole planet's Earth link averages 0.965 Mbps = 10.7 GB/sol (relay card: 65 Tb per synodic period). In exceeds out by 1.44x - this site is not a relay, it is where science data lands, is reduced and is kept; Earth receives a selection. The relay card says the same from its side: 'the hard ceiling on science output is the Earth link'.

pois.physics: 「快收慢送」是中继体系的本质(中继卡的话),星上存储是变速箱;到了地面,变速箱就是这间机房的盘。上合两周的缓存只有 0.22 TB,而归档一火星年 10 TB——约束从来不在链路,在选什么送。
pois.physics_en: 'Receive fast, send slow' is the nature of a relay system (the relay card's words) and on-board storage is its gearbox; on the ground the gearbox is this room's disks. Two weeks of conjunction buffer is 0.22 TB while a Mars year of archive is 10 TB - the constraint was never the link, it is what to select for sending.

pois.detail: 机房在地表建筑里,不在地下城:头顶只有 20.7 g/cm² 的 CO₂ 柱,地表剂量 234 mSv/yr(sci-rad-01 的口径,墙未折入)。屋顶这个节点是 sci-rad-01 三层辐射网地表层的一个分点。SEU/SEL 率仍不能闭合,而且现在是持有方亲口确认的不能闭合:sci-rad-01 两次回执(09-08、09-09)说明本站没有任何实测谱,只有背景知识量级,并定义了将来出谱后它能交付什么。本账据此重算:把 SEU 写成对器件截面的扫描而不选值,把平静与 SEP 两种工况分开,把未知写成未知。

The node on the roof is a point of sci-rad-01's three-tier radiation net, surface tier. SEU/SEL rates are still not closable, and now the holder itself has confirmed it: sci-rad-01's two replies (09-08, 09-09) say the station holds no measured spectrum, only background-knowledge magnitudes, and define what its chain would deliver once data exist. This account was re-based on that: SEU as a sweep over the device cross-section with no value chosen, quiet and SEP conditions kept apart, unknowns written as unknown.

pois.physics: 翻转率 = 通量 × 截面 × 位数;不可纠率 ≈ 翻转率 × (每字翻转率 × 刷新间隔)。前者对通量和截面都线性,后者都是平方——截面差两个数量级,不可纠率差四个;硬 SEP 期间通量 ×3103,不可纠率 ×10⁷,平静时够用的刷新周期在事件里差七个数量级。所以刷新策略有两个旋钮:后台刷新周期(等 σ)和接 SEP 警报的加速刷新。3 /cm²/s 数的是每一条带电径迹(含次级),只有超过器件 LET 阈的那部分会翻转:它是上界,不是率。r1 把卡上 62 像素击中/s ÷ 片面积 = 8.93 当成粒子通量,2026-09-13 撤回(像素击中率不是粒子通量;持有方已把 62 本身更正为 ~198)。
pois.physics_en: Upset rate = flux x cross-section x bits; uncorrectable rate ~ upset rate x (per-word upset rate x scrub interval). The first is linear in flux and in cross-section, the second quadratic in both - two decades of sigma are four decades of uncorrectables, and a hard SEP (flux x3103) raises uncorrectables by 10^7, so a scrub interval that is ample in quiet time is seven decades short during the event. Hence two knobs: a background scrub interval (waiting on sigma) and an accelerated scrub triggered by the SEP alert. The 3 /cm2/s counts every charged track incl. secondaries; only the part above a device's LET threshold upsets it: it is a bound, not a rate. r1 read the card's 62 pixel hits/s divided by chip area = 8.93 as a particle flux; retired 2026-09-13 (a pixel-hit rate is not a particle flux; the holder has itself revised 62 to ~198).

The top band is annual dose-floor bars for living and working locations, with an empty frame where there is no basis; the middle band is one tile per person in the city, filled only where the dose column has a number and otherwise an empty frame - an empty frame means 'cannot be closed', never zero; the bottom band is the sols to 20 mSv under several village EVA schedules. The data is imported from roster-data.js at build time; ops-roster-01 generates and versions it, and this card transcribes none of its numbers - the screen reads whatever version roster.json is at (the build-time version is recorded in userData.roster). Why here: this room is where the city's science data lands and is kept (see the datalink card), and this screen reads out what the city knows, and does not know, about its own people.

pois.physics: 看板是一张没有字的条形图:长度 ∝ 地板/234(无屏蔽地表满格),颜色是来源等级(琥珀 = 裁定下界、红 = 实测、空框 = 无依据)。把「不知道」画成空框而不是短条,是这块屏唯一的纪律——短条会被读成「剂量低」,空框只能被读成「没有数」。
pois.physics_en: The board is a bar chart with no words: length proportional to floor/234 (the unshielded surface fills the bar), colour is the grade of the source (amber = ruled lower bound, red = measured, empty frame = no basis). Drawing 'unknown' as an empty frame rather than a short bar is the one discipline of this screen - a short bar reads as 'low dose', an empty frame can only read as 'no number'.
